points.description: States that a class can have an unlimited number of constructors (no fixed limit on how many can be created).
points.partial_credit: Half (1.5) if the student says 'many/multiple' constructors without stating there is no limit.

points.description: Correctly qualifies that the constructors are distinguished by differing parameter lists, i.e. constructor overloading (each must have a different signature).
points.partial_credit: Half (1) if overloading or differing parameters is mentioned only vaguely without the term 'overloading' or 'parameter list/signature'.

rubric.notes: Full marks need the precise claim that the number is unlimited (no fixed upper limit). Saying only 'many' or 'more than one' earns at most half of P1. Any specific finite number (e.g. one, two, three) or saying it is limited earns nothing for P1. P2 is only earned if overloading/different parameter lists is stated correctly; a wrong statement there earns nothing for P2.
